card.name: Hydrate endings in drug salt names
card.fires_on: The 'dr' or 'hydrate' piece inside hydrate salt names such as monohydrate, dihydrate and hexahydrate. It fires right before the final 'ate' or 'inhalation aerosol' ends the name.

modes.label: Split hydrate
modes.description: The 'dr' piece in a word split as hy-dr-ate, after a prefix like mono or hexa.
modes.example: received in one tablet of PSORIZIDE ® ULTRA. Nickel sulphate toxicity The oral rat LD 50 for nickel sulphate hexahy<<dr>>ate is 275 mg/kg

modes.label: Whole hydrate after di
modes.description: The whole word 'hydrate' after 'fumarate di' in budesonide and formoterol labels.
modes.example: ists As with other inhaled drugs containing beta 2 -adrenergic agents, budesonide and formoterol fumarate di<<hydrate>> inhalation aerosol should not be used

card.plain: It marks the hydrate part of a chemical name, like monohydrate or dihydrate, in a drug's name.
